newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka postpones estate firm sale.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka postpones estate firm sale.

text.p: Sri Lanka has postponed the sale of a strategic holding in Elkaduwa Plantations Ltd, which was to take place on the stock exchange on Wednesday, a government official said.
"The sale has been put off for a further date, which will be decided later," said an official of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission, which oversees privatisations.
The official, who declined to be identified, did not give a reason for the postponement.
Elkaduwa was one of four estate firms where the government was selling 51 percent or 10.2 million shares to a strategic investor as part of its plantation sector reform programme.
Malwatte Plantations was sold at 61 rupees a 10-rupee share last Friday, Kahawatte Plantations at 30.25 rupees per share on Monday and Elpitiya Plantations at 30.25 rupees a share on Tuesday.
